With leave of the Appellate Court, a person claiming to be an aggrieved party can approach the Court only if he can establish prima facie that he is an affected party or prejudiced due to the order impugned. Therefore, a person cannot be brought under the definition of aggrieved party if such a person being not happy about the benefit granted to some party comes before the higher authority challenging the benefit. He has to establish that the order impugned has caused a legal grievance to him adversely affecting his interest or wrongfully a benefit is refused to him.
